description: This file defines the SugaredValue class hierarchy and related classes used in the Torch JIT frontend for representing and manipulating Python-like syntax sugar in the IR conversion process.

classes.name: SugaredValue
classes.description: Abstract base class for representing Python-like syntax sugar in the Torch JIT frontend.

classes.name: SimpleValue
classes.description: Represents a simple value in the SugaredValue hierarchy, wrapping a Torch IR Value.

classes.name: BuiltinFunction
classes.description: Represents a built-in function or operator, such as aten::relu.

classes.name: SugaredTupleValue
classes.description: Represents a tuple of SugaredValues.

classes.name: BuiltinModule
classes.description: Represents a built-in module, e.g., torch or torch.nn.

classes.name: ClassValue
classes.description: Represents a class type, allowing constructor and attribute access.

classes.name: NamedTupleConstructor
classes.description: Represents a constructor for named tuples.

classes.name: FunctionValue
classes.description: Represents a function, including its schema and call behavior.

classes.name: ClosureValue
classes.description: Represents a closure value, typically a captured function or block.

classes.name: MethodValue
classes.description: Represents a method obtained from a class or interface.

classes.name: PrintValue
classes.description: Represents a print operation.

classes.name: CastValue
classes.description: Represents a type cast operation.

classes.name: TensorCastValue
classes.description: Represents a tensor type cast operation.

classes.name: MagicMethod
classes.description: Represents a built-in operator or method like len or +.

classes.name: SpecialFormValue
classes.description: Represents special forms like isinstance, fork, annotate.

classes.name: LegacyTensorConstructor
classes.description: Represents legacy tensor creation syntax.

classes.name: RangeValue
classes.description: Represents a range object, used in for loops and enumerate.

classes.name: IterableTree
classes.description: Represents a tree structure of iterable expressions like zip and enumerate.

classes.name: SimpleSelf
classes.description: Represents a simple self object for class types.

classes.name: ExceptionMessageValue
classes.description: Represents an exception message value.

classes.name: ExceptionValue
classes.description: Represents an exception with a message.

classes.name: SugaredEnumClass
classes.description: Represents an enum class.

classes.name: SliceValue
classes.description: Represents a Python slice object.

classes.name: TorchCheckValue
classes.description: Represents a torch._check operation.

methods.name: kind
methods.description: Returns a string describing the kind of SugaredValue.

methods.name: asValue
methods.description: Converts SugaredValue to a Torch IR Value.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Accesses an attribute of the SugaredValue.

methods.name: hasAttr
methods.description: Checks if the SugaredValue has a given attribute.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Sets an attribute on the SugaredValue.

methods.name: asTuple
methods.description: Converts SugaredValue to a tuple of SugaredValues.

methods.name: asTupleValue
methods.description: Converts SugaredValue to a tuple value.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls the SugaredValue as a function.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the length of the SugaredValue if applicable.

methods.name: getitem
methods.description: Gets an item from the SugaredValue.
